title: 第一卷 第13章 极品丹药的价值第一卷 第14章 王家的谋划
slug: 我为族长当缔造诸天万界之禁忌家族
content_zh:
“真的是极品聚气丹！”
“比万宝阁售卖的上品聚气丹都要强上数倍！”
三位长老你看我，我看你，都从对方眼中看到了难以置信。
这么多极品丹药，数量起码都有几千枚，这简直超出了他们的想象。
“族长，这些丹药是从哪里来的？”
大长老顾青云深吸了一口气，压下心中的激动，看向顾天阳问道。
他实在无法想象，顾天阳是如何弄到这么多极品丹药的。
万宝阁就算有这么多存货，也不是顾家现在能买得起的。
顾天阳微微一笑，语气平淡地说道：
“这些丹药，都是我炼制的。”
“什么？”
三位长老听后，瞬间僵在了原地。
脸上的表情凝固，嘴巴张得能塞进一个鸡蛋，惊掉了下巴。
“族长，您说什么？”
“这些丹药，都是您亲手炼制的？”
大长老顾青云声音颤抖，不敢相信自己的耳朵。
顾青海和顾青河也纷纷看向顾天阳，眼中充满了震撼。
他们顾家什么时候有炼丹师了？
而且还是能炼制出如此多极品丹药的炼丹师？
顾天阳点点头，语气肯定地说道：

“没错，都是我炼制的。”
“我以前偶得一份炼丹传承，便尝试炼制了一些精元丹和聚气丹，没想到效果还不错。”
三位长老这才回过神来，心中掀起了惊涛骇浪。
偶得一份传承就能炼制出如此多的极品丹药？
这简直就是丹道大师啊！
要知道，炼丹师在修行界极为稀缺，青云城这么大的城池，也没有几位真正的炼丹师。
那些炼丹师一个个眼高于顶，炼制的丹药价格高昂。
而且往往要排队预约，普通家族根本难以接触到。
顾家以前想要丹药，只能去万宝阁高价采购，而且买到的大多是下品丹药。
大长老作为家族高层，一个月也只能分到三枚聚气丹，还是下品。
那些炼体境的家族子弟，每个月更是只能分到两枚下品精元丹。
根本不够用，修为进展缓慢。
而现在，顾天阳竟然一次性拿出了近万枚丹药，而且都是上品和极品丹药。
这对于顾家而言，简直是雪中送炭。
不，是天降横财！
“族长，这得有近万颗丹药了吧？”
三长老顾青河颤声说道。
他大体数了一下，每个玉瓶都装着上百颗丹药，数十个玉瓶加起来，数量极为惊人。
“精元丹四千五百颗，聚气丹四千五百颗。”
顾天阳准确的报出了丹药数量。
content_en:
"It's really the best Qi Gathering Pill!"
"It's several times stronger than the top-grade Qi Gathering Pill sold in Wanbao Pavilion!"
The three elders looked at me and I looked at you, and they all saw disbelief in each other's eyes.
There were so many top-grade elixirs, numbering at least several thousand, which was simply beyond their imagination.
"Clan leader, where do these pills come from?"
The Great Elder Gu Qingyun took a deep breath, suppressed the excitement in his heart, looked at Gu Tianyang and asked.
He really couldn't imagine how Gu Tianyang obtained so many top-grade elixirs.
Even if Wanbao Pavilion has so much inventory, it is not something that the Gu family can afford now.
Gu Tianyang smiled slightly and said calmly:
"These elixirs are all refined by me."
"What?"
After hearing this, the three elders instantly froze on the spot.
The expression on his face froze, his mouth opened wide enough to fit an egg in, and his jaw dropped.
"Clan leader, what did you say?"
"Did you personally refine these elixirs?"
The Great Elder Gu Qingyun's voice was trembling, and he couldn't believe his ears.
Gu Qinghai and Gu Qinghe also looked at Gu Tianyang, their eyes full of shock.
Since when did their Gu family have an alchemist?
And he is still an alchemist who can refine so many top-grade elixirs?
Gu Tianyang nodded and said with certainty:
"That's right, I refined them all."
"I got an alchemy inheritance by chance before, so I tried to refine some Essence Pills and Qi Gathering Pills. Unexpectedly, the results were pretty good."
Only then did the three elders come to their senses, feeling a storm in their hearts.
Can you refine so many top-grade elixirs with just a piece of inheritance?
This is simply a master of alchemy!
You know, alchemists are extremely rare in the world of cultivation. In a city as big as Qingyun City, there are not many real alchemists.
Those alchemists are all high-minded, and the elixirs they refine are very expensive.
Moreover, you often have to queue up to make an appointment, making it difficult for ordinary families to access them.
If the Gu family wanted elixirs before, they could only go to Wanbao Pavilion to buy them at high prices, and most of the elixirs they bought were low-grade elixirs.
As a senior member of the family, the Great Elder can only receive three Qi Gathering Pills a month, which are still of low quality.
Those family members who are in the Body Refining Realm can only get two low-grade Jingyuan Pills every month.
There is simply not enough, and the progress of cultivation is slow.
But now, Gu Tianyang actually took out nearly ten thousand elixirs at once, and they were all top-grade and top-grade elixirs.
For the Gu family, this is a timely help.
No, it’s a windfall from heaven!
"Clan leader, there must be nearly ten thousand pills, right?"
Third Elder Gu Qinghe said in a trembling voice.
He roughly counted and found that each jade bottle contained hundreds of pills. The total number of dozens of jade bottles was extremely staggering.
"Four thousand and five hundred Essence Pills and four thousand five hundred Qi Gathering Pills."
Gu Tianyang accurately reported the number of pills.
